The [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] '''MacroMotionMonitor''' was a personal external [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] array attached to [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmets]]. It detected motion within the wearer's visual range and was capable of picking up motion up to fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away. The unit transmitted an audial signal corresponding to speed and direction.<ref name="GG10" />
